subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-shortened path display, switch user-facing agent file references to full absolute paths by default, or add a narrowly documented display preference?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally compact home paths, and the earlier env-var proposal closed unmerged; changing the default or adding a setting affects UX and configuration policy beyond a strict bug fix.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display policy and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt guidance so home-contained file references render as full absolute paths by default.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Add a documented setting or env var for users who need full absolute paths while keeping current defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display policy and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the central shortening helper and has the strongest history signal for the display-policy decision.
